verdict.rationale: Fern Agent automations can run on a schedule, review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries or analytics, then report findings or open a pull request (fern-docs-8, fern-docs-25). Fern Agent can also be started from Slack to open PRs (fern-docs-45). These are time-based or manually started prompts, not user-defined rules that fire on events. Missing for 10: event-driven triggers (e.g. on publish, feedback received, or webhook), a rule/condition configuration model, documentation of the trigger options and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
